entries.486b86b740f12b6b: It provides international telecommunications lines for the Philippines, internet connection services for corporations locally in the Philippines, sales of domestic voice communications services and call center systems, and operates ophthalmology clinics and medical checkup and health screening centers in the Philippines.
entries.4c06bede30c8b1b6: Under its corporate philosophy “Open Door,” it aims to create business opportunities ahead of anyone else, develop businesses and change industry structures in fields closely tied to daily life that have barriers no one has yet broken through. In the International Telecommunications Business, it will expand wholesale services for telecommunications operators (carrier’s carrier) and internet connection services for corporations, using a network that combines C2C lines and the Philippine domestic submarine cable network (PDSCN). It will also strengthen its international telecommunications infrastructure through participation in the joint construction of the new international submarine cable “Candle” and construction of a cable landing station in the Philippines. In the Domestic Telecommunications Business, it will continue to provide solution services for call centers and advance preparations to launch a new service in which the company itself offers “0120” and similar numbers under which the receiving party is charged, prompted by the IP conversion of telephone networks. In the Medical & Healthcare Business, it will work to provide LASIK surgery stably and to promote preventive medicine through human dock and health checkup centers that follow Japanese standards.

entries.e63908c4da759083: Its strength lies in its position as the third international telecommunications carrier in the Philippines, after the 2 major telecommunications operators that own and operate submarine cable rights. By combining international lines using the right of use of C2C lines with the Philippine domestic backbone network centered on PDSCN, completed in December 2023, the group can handle everything in-house, from providing international telecommunications lines to internet connection services for domestic corporations. Its core subsidiary, InfiniVAN, Inc., holds the qualification (CPCN) for telecommunications business in the Philippines and has also been allocated frequencies for use in 5G.
entries.efce988ea1aa9ae6: It provides international communication lines connecting the Philippines with North America, Hong Kong and other locations to internet connection providers such as CATV operators in the Philippines, and also sells communication equipment. It participates in the joint construction of the international submarine cable “Candle” connecting Japan, the Philippines and Singapore, and its subsidiary InfiniVAN, Inc. provides corporate internet connection services and communication lines in the Philippines. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥12,943 million, the largest among the 3 reportable segments.
